errors.fix: Treat 'not my address' and 'send to another address' as a decline. Do not re-ask. Close with 'Sizi ana menüye yönlendiriyorum.'

errors.rule: Spec 4.9 and scorer rule: amounts are read in words (Turkish wording, with sent for cents).
errors.what: Agent read amounts as digits: '120 Dolar', '48 Dolar', '240 Euro 50 sent', '96 Euro 20 sent'. The values match the service data.
errors.fix: Say 'yüz yirmi dolar', 'kırk sekiz dolar', 'iki yüz kırk euro elli sent', 'doksan altı euro yirmi sent'.

errors.rule: Spec 4.8: the due-date sentence takes the suffix 'dır/dir' after the date.
errors.what: Agent said 'Borçlarınız için son ödeme tarihiniz 15 Ekim 2026.' The suffix is missing.
errors.fix: Say 'Borçlarınız için son ödeme tarihiniz 15 Ekim 2026'dır.'

correct: Card found with cards.list, a single card, so no card question was asked.
Intro 'Sonu sıfır dört bir bir ile biten Yıldız Miles' reads the last four digit by digit, and the closing date 5 Ekim 2026 is on the first currency read (Dolar), because TL has no debt.
Amounts and dates match the service data: USD 120 / min 48, EUR 240.50 / min 96.20, due 15.10.2026. Nothing is made up.
The no-debt sentence 'Türk Lirası ve İngiliz Sterlini borcunuz bulunmamaktadır.' is correct and uses full currency names.
contact.email.get was called before the offer. The offer 'Hesap kesim tarihinizi değiştirebilirim ya da ekstrenizi kayıtlı mail adresinize gönderebilirim.' matches the table.
The e-mail confirmation question was asked before any action, and the address was read in short form without spelling it out.
statement.pdf.send was never called, so nothing went to the new address. There was no leak and no digits beyond the last four.
verdict.tester_issue: The tester summary is inaccurate. It says the assistant 'said it can only send to the registered address' and that it refused the address change. The assistant never said the address cannot be changed on this call. The tester also ended the call right after the agent re-asked, so the missing main-menu close is an agent fault. The tester did not deviate from the script. The persona 'expect' field matches the spec.
